who-we-are.title: We build technology that moves businesses forward
who-we-are.intro: Sakinzo is a product engineering partner helping ambitious companies turn complex ideas into reliable digital products.
who-we-are.heading: Technology expertise with a business-first mindset
who-we-are.body: We combine strategy, design, engineering and long-term support in one accountable team. Our work is grounded in clarity, measurable outcomes and products people genuinely enjoy using.
cards: We challenge assumptions and shape the right product before writing code.
Scalable architecture, clean delivery practices and quality built into every release.
Transparent communication and a team that stays invested beyond launch.

careers.title: Do meaningful work with people who care
careers.intro: Join a curious, collaborative team building products for real-world challenges.
careers.heading: Build your next chapter at Sakinzo
careers.body: We value ownership, thoughtful craft and continuous learning. You will work closely with clients and teammates, contribute to important decisions and see the impact of what you build.
cards: A supportive environment built around trust, focus and sustainable pace.
Mentorship, challenging projects and room to explore new technologies.
We welcome engineers, designers, analysts and product thinkers who want to grow.

leadership.title: Leadership grounded in delivery
leadership.intro: Our leaders bring together product vision, technical depth and a commitment to lasting client relationships.
leadership.heading: The people guiding our mission
leadership.body: Sakinzo leadership stays close to projects, customers and teams. That hands-on perspective helps us make better decisions and maintain the high standards our partners expect.
cards: Keeping business outcomes at the center of every engagement.
Building strong engineering foundations for secure, scalable products.
Creating an environment where talented teams can do their best work.

ev-charging.title: A connected cloud ecosystem for EV charging
ev-charging.intro: A scalable platform bringing chargers, drivers, operators and payments into one reliable experience.
ev-charging.heading: Powering a smarter charging network
ev-charging.body: We designed an IoT-enabled cloud ecosystem that gives operators real-time visibility while making charging simple for drivers. The platform supports device communication, session management, billing and operational analytics.
cards: Unify fragmented charging infrastructure and operational workflows.
Cloud services, real-time device data and intuitive operator tools.
Faster operations, better reliability and a foundation ready to scale.

market-access.title: AI-based market access planning
market-access.intro: Turning complex market signals into clear, evidence-based expansion decisions.
market-access.heading: From scattered data to confident planning
market-access.body: The solution brings market, competitor and internal data together, then applies AI-assisted analysis to surface opportunities and risks. Teams can compare scenarios and build stronger go-to-market plans.
cards: Manual research made planning slow and inconsistent.
A unified analytics workspace with AI-supported recommendations.
Shorter research cycles and clearer market prioritization.

multi-currency-wallet.title: A secure multi-currency wallet experience
multi-currency-wallet.intro: One platform for holding, exchanging and transferring funds across currencies.
multi-currency-wallet.heading: Making global money movement feel simple
multi-currency-wallet.body: We engineered a secure fintech experience around complex ledger, compliance and exchange workflows. Customers get a clear interface while operations teams retain control and visibility.
cards: Deliver speed without compromising financial controls.
Secure wallet architecture, transaction workflows and auditability.
A smoother customer journey ready for regional growth.

iot-cloud-platform.title: An IoT cloud platform built to scale
iot-cloud-platform.intro: Connecting distributed devices with dependable monitoring, control and analytics.
iot-cloud-platform.heading: A single operational view of every device
iot-cloud-platform.body: The platform securely ingests device data, manages fleets and makes critical events visible to operations teams. Its modular cloud architecture supports new device types and use cases.
cards: Manage growing fleets across disconnected systems.
Secure ingestion, device management and real-time dashboards.
Improved visibility, response time and platform extensibility.

smart-hvac.title: Smart HVAC monitoring powered by AI
smart-hvac.intro: Predictive insights that help teams reduce downtime and operate buildings more efficiently.
smart-hvac.heading: Moving maintenance from reactive to proactive
smart-hvac.body: Sensor data and machine learning identify unusual behavior before it becomes a costly failure. Teams receive actionable alerts and a clear view of equipment health.
cards: Failures were difficult to predict and expensive to resolve.
IoT telemetry, anomaly detection and prioritized alerts.
Earlier intervention, better uptime and smarter energy use.
